```{r}
#| include: false

## 404 page. GitHub Pages serves docs/404.html for any address it can't find,
## including nested ones (/a/b/c.html), so its styles, scripts, images and
## links must not be relative to the page: for a 404.qmd Quarto writes them
## from the site root (it knows the root from site-url), and leaves the page
## out of the sitemap. No aliases point here.
## The title banner, then a day band (on the site's 1168px column) with a
## line of text, four cards in the home page's door pattern (title, a line,
## and a link that makes the whole card clickable) and the contact email.
## Uses only classes from styles/bml.scss (body class bml-page-404 lines the
## banner up with the column).

## load packages and setup (labEmail and mailtoUrl() for the email link)
source("package_setup.R", echo = FALSE)
```
